remarks: Life is better by the Sound! Close to the Darien border & just a few blocks from Cove Island's 83 acre beach & park, prepare to be WOWED by this 6BR, 2FBA (plus bonus space) 2-Family, totally refreshed w/tasteful, modern colors & aesthetics inside & out. Enjoy hassle-free ownership - hand the keys right over & start generating immediate income (or unpack & move right in). 4 unobstructed off-street parking spaces (2 cars per unit), such a great investment! Perks continue: Each unit has a dedicated washer/dryer, private entrance & separate utilities (electric meter & newer gas-fired water heater & boiler). Unit 1 also has 2 more rooms (for a total of 7) which can potentially be integrated into finished living space. More bonus points: Tap additional income from detached garage/storage shed plus 3 ready-to-rent storage rooms in the walk-out, tiled basement (NOT included in reported sqft). All of this, yet located just a 1/2 mile to Cove Island park & beach on Long Island Sound (w/walking paths, marina, tennis courts, bird sanctuary & Terry Conners ice rink) & between 1/2mi to 2 1/2mi to even more amenities & conveniences including Cummings Beach & Park (tennis & pickleball), West Beach (soccer fields), Chelsea Piers, I-95, Stamford & Noroton Heights RR stations & downtown Stamford, Harbor Point, Shippan & Darien/Noroton Heights shops, restaurants & entertainment. An extraordinary, unexpected opportunity awaits you in a prime beach location! Let the rent start rolling today!
